name: Activity trend
sql:
select to_char(b.bucket,case b.grain when 'MONTH' then 'YYYY-MM' when 'HOUR' then 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24' else 'YYYY-MM-DD' end) label,o.series,nvl(c.value,0) value
 from (
 select case grain when 'MONTH' then add_months(trunc(f,'MM'),level-1) when 'HOUR' then f+(level-1)/24 else f+level-1 end bucket,grain
 from (select (select /*+ no_unnest */ case when validate_conversion(apex_util.get_session_state('P1100_FROM') as date,'FXYYYY-MM-DD')=1 then to_date(apex_util.get_session_state('P1100_FROM'),'FXYYYY-MM-DD') end from dual) f,(select /*+ no_unnest */ case when validate_conversion(apex_util.get_session_state('P1100_TO') as date,'FXYYYY-MM-DD')=1 then to_date(apex_util.get_session_state('P1100_TO'),'FXYYYY-MM-DD') end from dual) t,case when :P1100_GRAIN='MONTH' then 'MONTH' when (:P1100_GRAIN='HOUR' and (select /*+ no_unnest */ case when validate_conversion(apex_util.get_session_state('P1100_TO') as date,'FXYYYY-MM-DD')=1 then to_date(apex_util.get_session_state('P1100_TO'),'FXYYYY-MM-DD') end from dual)-(select /*+ no_unnest */ case when validate_conversion(apex_util.get_session_state('P1100_FROM') as date,'FXYYYY-MM-DD')=1 then to_date(apex_util.get_session_state('P1100_FROM'),'FXYYYY-MM-DD') end from dual)<=6) or (:P1100_GRAIN='DAY' and (select /*+ no_unnest */ case when validate_conversion(apex_util.get_session_state('P1100_TO') as date,'FXYYYY-MM-DD')=1 then to_date(apex_util.get_session_state('P1100_TO'),'FXYYYY-MM-DD') end from dual)=(select /*+ no_unnest */ case when validate_conversion(apex_util.get_session_state('P1100_FROM') as date,'FXYYYY-MM-DD')=1 then to_date(apex_util.get_session_state('P1100_FROM'),'FXYYYY-MM-DD') end from dual)) then 'HOUR' else 'DAY' end grain from dual) connect by level<=case grain when 'MONTH' then months_between(trunc(t,'MM'),trunc(f,'MM'))+1 when 'HOUR' then (t-f+1)*24 else t-f+1 end) b cross join (select 'INSERT' series from dual union all select 'UPDATE' from dual union all select 'DELETE' from dual) o left join (select case p.grain when 'MONTH' then trunc(e.local_timestamp,'MM') when 'HOUR' then trunc(e.local_timestamp,'HH24') else trunc(e.local_timestamp) end bucket,e.operation series,count(*) value
 from IMART_ACTIVITY_SCOPE_V e cross join (select (select /*+ no_unnest */ case when validate_conversion(apex_util.get_session_state('P1100_FROM') as date,'FXYYYY-MM-DD')=1 then to_date(apex_util.get_session_state('P1100_FROM'),'FXYYYY-MM-DD') end from dual) f,(select /*+ no_unnest */ case when validate_conversion(apex_util.get_session_state('P1100_TO') as date,'FXYYYY-MM-DD')=1 then to_date(apex_util.get_session_state('P1100_TO'),'FXYYYY-MM-DD') end from dual) t,case when :P1100_GRAIN='MONTH' then 'MONTH' when (:P1100_GRAIN='HOUR' and (select /*+ no_unnest */ case when validate_conversion(apex_util.get_session_state('P1100_TO') as date,'FXYYYY-MM-DD')=1 then to_date(apex_util.get_session_state('P1100_TO'),'FXYYYY-MM-DD') end from dual)-(select /*+ no_unnest */ case when validate_conversion(apex_util.get_session_state('P1100_FROM') as date,'FXYYYY-MM-DD')=1 then to_date(apex_util.get_session_state('P1100_FROM'),'FXYYYY-MM-DD') end from dual)<=6) or (:P1100_GRAIN='DAY' and (select /*+ no_unnest */ case when validate_conversion(apex_util.get_session_state('P1100_TO') as date,'FXYYYY-MM-DD')=1 then to_date(apex_util.get_session_state('P1100_TO'),'FXYYYY-MM-DD') end from dual)=(select /*+ no_unnest */ case when validate_conversion(apex_util.get_session_state('P1100_FROM') as date,'FXYYYY-MM-DD')=1 then to_date(apex_util.get_session_state('P1100_FROM'),'FXYYYY-MM-DD') end from dual)) then 'HOUR' else 'DAY' end grain from dual) p where e.operation in ('INSERT','UPDATE','DELETE')
 group by case p.grain when 'MONTH' then trunc(e.local_timestamp,'MM') when 'HOUR' then trunc(e.local_timestamp,'HH24') else trunc(e.local_timestamp) end,e.operation) c on c.bucket=b.bucket and c.series=o.series
 where exists(select 1 from IMART_ACTIVITY_SCOPE_V where operation in ('INSERT','UPDATE','DELETE')) order by label,series

name: Operation distribution
sql: select operation label,operation series,count(*) value from IMART_ACTIVITY_SCOPE_V group by operation

name: Module activity (top 12 plus others)
sql:
select case when r.rn<=12 then e.module_name else 'Other modules' end label,e.operation series,count(*) value,case when r.rn<=12 then e.module_code else '~OTHER~' end drill_key
 from IMART_ACTIVITY_SCOPE_V e join (select module_code,row_number() over(order by count(*) desc,module_code) rn from IMART_ACTIVITY_SCOPE_V group by module_code) r on r.module_code=e.module_code
 group by case when r.rn<=12 then e.module_name else 'Other modules' end,e.operation,case when r.rn<=12 then e.module_code else '~OTHER~' end

name: Top active ERP users
sql: select user_name label,'Events' series,count(*) value from IMART_ACTIVITY_SCOPE_V where source_type='APEX_USER' and user_name is not null group by user_name order by value desc,user_name fetch first 10 rows only

name: Company and location comparison
sql: select company_name||' / '||location_name label,'Events' series,count(*) value,company_code drill_key,location_code drill_location from IMART_ACTIVITY_SCOPE_V group by company_name,location_name,company_code,location_code

name: Exception categories
sql: select exception_reason label,'Events' series,count(*) value from IMART_ACTIVITY_SCOPE_V where exception_reason is not null group by exception_reason
